patterns: SNL comedy crossover owns the board: Druski’s You Can See Everything parody (2.29M), Druski’s monologue with Emma Stone (1.17M), FilmUpdates’ Emma Stone appearance (597k), FilmUpdates’ parody recut (128k).
Wholesome meme spike: DiscussingFilm’s ‘me when I meet wallace & gromit’ reaction clip hits 929k — second-lane engagement, not news.
Franchise-expansion news: Heated Rivalry filming S2+S3 back-to-back plus a Scott & Kip theatrical standalone for Dec 2027 (720k + 392k).

First-look / trailer stack: live-action The Hunchback (Vincent Cassel, Netflix Nov 27) first trailer at 520k; Percy Jackson S3 poster (333k); I Play Rocky clip (209k); Dune: Part Three promo art (231k).

Casting wishlist + Bond process: Bill Skarsgård wants Constantine with Muschietti (499k); Villeneuve tells Variety he’s having a ‘great time’ screen-testing Bond (90k); CinemaTweets1 ‘Make This Man Bond Immediately’ (16k).

Box-office records: Godzilla Minus Zero opens $31.6M — biggest live-action international domestic open (170k); You Can See Everything tracking toward $100M domestic as a documentary (172k); Clayface $109M WW on a $44M budget (79k).
Toy-to-screen hangover: LEGO Interstellar set in the works (478k) the day after LEGO Ninjago anime’s 6.27M trailer post.
Red-carpet volume play: LACMA Art+Film Gala stack (Anya, Kidman, Viola, Villeneuve, Chalamet, Barbaro, Withers) in the 36k–61k band.
Classic BTS / evergreen: ATRightMovies’ Eddie Murphy Beverly Hills Cop improv leads that lane at 185k; Nolan Odyssey practical-effects explainers (Laestrygonian 125k, Cyclops 37k).
Fresh late-window headline: Spielberg’s next film is a Western he hopes to shoot next year (96k on DiscussingFilm, still climbing).
narrative_synthesis: SNL ate the timeline overnight: DiscussingFilm’s Druski parody of You Can See Everything leads at 2,285,754 views, then Druski’s Emma Stone monologue (1,165,046) and a Wallace & Gromit reaction clip (929,254). Secondary lanes: Heated Rivalry S2+S3 plus a Scott & Kip 2027 movie (720k), Hunchback live-action trailer (520k), Skarsgård-for-Constantine (499k), LEGO Interstellar (478k). Box office: Godzilla Minus Zero’s $31.6M record international open (170k) and You Can See Everything tracking $100M as a documentary (172k). Bond process continues via Villeneuve (‘great time’ screen-testing, 90k). Watchlist originals ≥5k views: 71 (RealEmirHan silent). Meta: comedy-crossover clips and franchise-expansion news beat pure casting polls today.
